narrative.name: Bitcoin
narrative.regimeNote: H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -9.97 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP
narrative.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -9.97 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 65912.9-75695.8 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 76002.7; the first objective pays 0.22R at 65343.5.

plan.triggerRule: footprint trap fired sell in short direction at the zone (absorption inside the zone)
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 76002.7 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 R 0.70 < 1.5 — reward does not pay the risk

factors.value: H4 down · D1 down · spread -9.97 ATR

views.method: structural prior (reflection-principle + gambler's ruin + checklist log-odds)

probability.method: reflection-principle first passage + gambler's ruin + checklist log-odds edge
caveats: zone-edge sensitivity: EV up to 0.87R on a far-edge fill (75695.8)

notes: riskReversal25d approximated: call IV at the strike nearest 1.1x spot vs put IV nearest 0.9x spot (book-summary rows carry no deltas)
oiWalls oiUsd = open_interest (BTC/ETH contracts) x underlying_price
gex: gamma computed via Black-Scholes (r=0, q=0) from mark_iv + underlying_price + time-to-expiry
gex: netGexUsd = sum(call OI x gamma) - sum(put OI x gamma); netGexUsdPer1Pct scales it by spot^2 x 1%
gex.gammaFlipPrice: zero-gamma root of the OI-weighted dealer gamma profile over a 0.70x-1.30x spot grid (expiries <= 90d, 510 legs) — above it dealer hedging stabilizes, below it accelerates
